digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend transport implementation
propositions: The DC transport lacks twelve methods the core requires for writing passes, causing either silent degradation (swallowed exceptions at call sites) or crashes on rare paths
Silent failures dominate: seven methods' call sites swallow all exceptions, so absent implementations appear to converge while corrupting data (missing comments, links, parents, properties)

The twelve missing methods require per-method triage—not bulk translation from Cloud—because Cloud's pagination (cursor-based), endpoint paths (/api/3 vs /api/2), and epic linking (fields.parent vs Greenhopper custom field) are incompatible with DC

The port declaration must be made @runtime_checkable with all required members specified, and conformance must be asserted at backend construction time rather than failing silently at call sites months later

Reporter sync requires both transport implementation AND a fix to inbound_fields._identity_of to read DC's 'name' field, otherwise the mutation re-emits on every pass indefinitely (idempotence breaks)

Transport member implementations must emit observable WARNING logs naming the member and remote id before errors propagate, since seven of the twelve have swallowed exception sites and will remain silent otherwise
